create_LambdaWarmUpCosineScheduler: create a LambdaWarmUpCosineScheduler with warm_up_steps, lr_min, lr_max, lr_start, and max_decay_steps parameters
call_LambdaWarmUpCosineScheduler_schedul: call the schedule method on LambdaWarmUpCosineScheduler to get the learning rate multiplier for a given step
